title: HB 4519 (88R): Relating to unlawful altering of election procedures.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.

(other) Sec 1: rewrites Election Code 276.019: bars public and election officials from altering election standards or procedures not expressly authorized; secretary of state written order to correct; referral to attorney general after two days; civil penalty $1,000 per day after day two, rising to $5,000 per day after day seven; attorney general may sue; penalties go to general revenue; documents not public information until certain determinations.
(other) Sec 2: effective date September 1, 2023.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
